Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company headquartered in Singapore, trading under the ticker STX and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001137789. Its website describes the company as a leader in mass-capacity data storage, stating it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades.

The site says AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements. Seagate states it is optimizing storage for AI and making what it calls unprecedented leaps forward in capacity to support efficient data center architecture and buildout. The site also discusses five strategic shifts to help close the gap between AI's growing data demands and infrastructure readiness.
